set.body: First implementation slice for the typed provenance epic. Add shared AtlasProvenance ADTs for identity, release, spatial support, artifact roles, source artifacts, label schema, derivation steps, citations, and validation issues. Wire Atlas, VolumeAtlas, and SurfaceAtlas to expose provenance while preserving AtlasRef compatibility. Update standard descriptors/loaders for Schaefer, Glasser, Brainnetome, ASEG, and surface descriptors to populate structured provenance from existing metadata. Add focused JVM/JS tests and docs for provenance completeness.
set.title: Atlas typed provenance first slice
